\newcommand{\smalltitle}[1]{{\vspace*{0.1cm}\begin{changemargin}{-2cm}{-2cm}\colorbox{shadecolor}{%
		\parbox[t]{21cm}{% Outer full width box
			\hspace*{1.8cm}\parbox[t]{17cm}{% Inner box for inner right text margin
				\sffamily\raggedright% Align text
				\fontsize{20pt}{28pt}\selectfont% Title font size, the first argument is the font size and the second is the line spacing, adjust depending on title length
				\vspace{0.3cm}{#1}\vspace{0.3cm}}}}\end{changemargin}\vspace{0.1cm}}}

\newcommand{\bigtitle}[1]{{\vspace*{0.5cm}\begin{changemargin}{-2cm}{-2cm}\colorbox{shadecolor}{%
		\parbox[t]{21cm}{% Outer full width box
			\hspace*{1.8cm}\parbox[t]{17cm}{% Inner box for inner right text margin
				\sffamily\raggedright% Align text
				\fontsize{32pt}{45pt}\selectfont% Title font size, the first argument is the font size and the second is the line spacing, adjust depending on title length
				\vspace{0.8cm}{#1}\vspace{0.8cm}}}}\end{changemargin}\vspace{0.5cm}}}
